relationships.subject: casein micelles
relationships.evidence_quote: micelles composed of casein protein (which is contained in skim milk) that remove pungent compounds bound to TRPV1 nanodisc, the deactivation of TRPV1 is investigated

key_findings: TRPV1 nanodisc graphene FET detects capsaicin down to 1 aM and other pungent compounds.
Casein micelles remove bound pungent compounds, making the electrode reusable.
